title: Try/Catch/Finally
description: Learn how to use try/catch/finally blocks to handle exceptions.

data.text: The try/catch/finally block lets you handle exceptions gracefully and execute cleanup code regardless of whether an error occurred.

data.title: Try/Catch
Multiple Catches
Finally
Using Statement
data.text: The using statement automatically disposes objects. It's cleaner than manual try/finally: `using var reader = new StreamReader("file.txt");`

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: try contains code that might throw
data.takeaway: Try/catch/finally keeps apps running when things go wrong.
